name: oli
description: Sovereign AI meeting copilot that lives in a notch-style overlay on Mac and Windows.

extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Oli listens to your microphone to transcribe your side of the conversation.
extendInfo.NSScreenCaptureUsageDescription: Oli captures shared meeting-tab or system audio so it can transcribe the other participants. No video or screen image is recorded.
